note: 从PR原加载器实际准入的公共库生成，仅用于桌面协议和渲染检查，不代表生产账号或本机认证。

ReportSection.description: One body section, in the already approved order. No extra fields.

heading.description: Copy the exact corresponding approved outline heading. Put scientific roles only in presentation.report.outline, not here.
heading.title: Heading

paragraphs.description: Write the complete body yourself. Bind ALL scientific numbers to available {{name}} tokens. Legal existing figure labels such as 图1/Figure 1 and consecutive list markers such as （1）…；（2）… are formatting. Do not write source hashes or paths in prose; they are retained automatically in sidecar records.
paragraphs.title: Paragraphs

figure_indices.description: Required zero-based indexes of actual approved figures placed in this section. Use [] if none. Across all sections include every actual figure exactly once. Body references 图1/Figure 1 use one-based labels.
figure_indices.title: Figure Indices

ReportSection.title: ReportSection

ReportText.description: Full model-written body, not a template or permission to invent numbers.

sections.description: Exactly the approved headings in order. Write methods, results, interpretation, diagnostics and limitations. Across the body use {{estimate}},{{ci_low}},{{ci_high}},{{p_value}},{{n}},{{excluded_rows}}. State synthetic-data limitations when source metadata says synthetic and state that this analysis does not establish causality. Use {{confidence_pct}}%, {{null_value}} and {{unit_increment}} instead of literal confidence/zero/unit-count numbers.
sections.title: Sections

allow_deterministic_continuation.description: REQUIRED explicit JSON boolean, no default. true authorizes assembly, layout and verification of THIS submitted text; false leaves continuation to the model. It never authorizes changing scientific prose.
allow_deterministic_continuation.title: Allow Deterministic Continuation

research_options.description: Supply at least the returned research_options_min when the user requests alternative studies; otherwise may omit. These model-written fields are inserted into an existing approved next_steps/limitations section.
research_options.title: Research Options

comparison_summary.description: Required when research_options is nonempty: compare their objectives and trade-offs using actual evidence; all scientific numbers use {{name}} tokens. Otherwise omit this field or put ordinary discussion in sections.
comparison_summary.title: Comparison Summary

ReportText.title: ReportText

ResearchOption.description: An LLM-written study choice; this schema does not judge its merit.

name.description: A distinct research/sampling option name; do not add fields beyond name,rationale,tradeoff.
name.title: Name

rationale.description: Explain why this option serves the actual findings/question. All quantitative values use verified {{name}} tokens.
rationale.title: Rationale

tradeoff.description: Explain costs, assumptions and limitations; describe untested scientific benefits as conditional hypotheses.
tradeoff.title: Tradeoff

ResearchOption.title: ResearchOption
